project.hypothesis: Effect-grounded, task-specific validation may measure generated-code jailbreak success more accurately than semantic and runtime-oriented evaluators.
project.candidate_note: Primary case-study recommendation from the control room. Selection and feasibility remain open.
project.decision: Test the narrow measurement question before committing to a full benchmark. The broad “first functional jailbreak validator” framing is not supported by the current synthesis.
project.scope_note: This dashboard contains a provisional reading queue and planning records from the synthesis. It is not an import of the Excel literature matrix. Paper findings and experiment measurements have not been populated.
project.novelty_note: Novelty remains under review. Missing or incomplete paper records do not establish a research gap.
